summary: Phase 5 fix-directive round 1 VERIFIED end-to-end. Backend pytest: 119/119 green (12 phase5 e2e + 3 receipts_immutability + all prior phases; 170s run, --ignore=tests/golden_resumes). P0 fix confirmed live: forcing state back to 'approved' via pymongo after a first submit+attest and re-submitting hits the duplicate-check branch — server returns HTTP 409 (NEVER 500), body is JSON-parseable, detail.error=='duplicate_application', detail.prior_receipt is a dict, detail.prior_receipt.ts is an ISO-8601 string (e.g. '2026-07-20T11:35:21.689000'). Full verbatim body captured below and in /app/test_reports/p5v2_live_output.txt. P1 fix confirmed live: after driving submitted→response, POST /api/v1/applications/{id}/interviews {stage:'recruiter_screen'} → 201 with body.transition == {from:'response', to:'interview'}, body.application_state=='interview', body.outcome.event=='interview_scheduled'. GET /api/v1/analytics/funnel then reports sample.interview==1 (SAMPLE-seeded job lands in sample bucket, not personal totals; totals.interview stays 0 as designed). POST /interviews/{iv_id}/qualified {qualified:true} → 200 qualified=true; funnel qi_total incremented to 1 (exposed at response ROOT, not nested under sample — see minor code-review note). P1 EDGE confirmed: scheduling from state='approved' returns 201 with transition==null, transition_error=='state_source_not_eligible_for_interview', application_state=='approved' (unchanged), AND the interview row + interview_scheduled outcome are both persisted in Mongo (append-only ledger). 4 UI screenshots persisted to /app/test_reports/p5v2-*.png — every requested element rendered verbatim (10-char hash, 'no prior application to this employer/req ✓', forward-address stub, card in interview column, analytics-sample-note with SAMPLE bucket text).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor spec-wording gap in review request: it says '`sample.qi_total` after: qi_total >= 1' but the implementation exposes `qi_total` at the root of the /analytics/funnel response (not nested inside the `sample` object). Numerically qi_total is 1 after the QI confirm — functional intent (counting the qualified interview) is satisfied. Consider either (a) mirroring qi_total inside `sample` for symmetry with sample.interview, or (b) updating spec docs to reflect the actual root-level shape. Not a bug — surfaced so the wire contract stays consistent with docs.

In domains/outcomes/service.py::schedule_interview, when current state is one not in {submitted, response, interview}, transition_error is set to 'state_source_not_eligible_for_interview' — good. But an InvalidTransition raised inside the try block quietly logs and sets transition_error='invalid_transition' WITHOUT returning a 409 or a specific error body, unlike the /outcomes endpoint which raises 409. This is deliberate (append-only interview row) and correct per spec, but the divergence in status semantics between /outcomes (409 on invalid) and /interviews (201 with transition_error string) is worth documenting for API consumers so they know to always inspect body.transition_error even on 201.

rca of the issue: N/A — both patches (P0 and P1) hold. P0: applications/service.py now wraps the duplicate-check HTTPException detail in fastapi.encoders.jsonable_encoder, so the raw pymongo datetime in prior_receipt.ts is serialized to an ISO-8601 string before starlette JSON-encodes the response (previously starlette hit a TypeError on the raw datetime and fell through to a 500). P1: outcomes/service.py::schedule_interview now (a) inserts the interview row, (b) appends an APPEND-ONLY interview_scheduled outcome, and (c) attempts atomic_transition from {submitted,response} → 'interview'; illegal source states return transition_error='state_source_not_eligible_for_interview' and still persist the row + outcome (append-only ledger). Verified by pytest suite + live-API capture + Playwright UI screenshots.
